verdict.rationale: Fathom ships a first-party REST API with SDKs and an MCP server. The documented endpoints mostly read data: list meetings, fetch transcripts and summaries, request downloads, list users and teams, plus create and delete webhooks. Many UI capabilities have no API evidence, including CRM field sync, clips and playlists, comments and folders, keyword alerts, scorecards, custom summaries and recording control, and API keys must be generated in the website settings UI. Missing for 10: write/management endpoints for UI features (playlists, clips, comments, folders, alerts, scorecards, CRM sync), programmatic API-key/recording control, an explicit API–UI parity statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: List the 10 most recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team.
If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.
Starts async generation of a downloadable file and returns a `download_id` to poll.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content.
List all users in the account with their permissions.
All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
